entries.not_relevant_because: The family proves Lech's inequality e(R) ≤ e(S) for flat local maps of Noetherian local rings. Along the way it proves a Dutta-multiplicity bound for short complexes over complete local domains of characteristic p (the domain case of Iyengar–Ma–Walker Conjecture 8.1), which is not among the named items. None of the fourteen named items is proved, stated or addressed: no zero-divisor, Bass, intersection, new or improved new intersection statement; no direct-summand, strong direct-summand, canonical-element, big Cohen–Macaulay, weakly functorial big Cohen–Macaulay, or Tor-vanishing statement; no Serre multiplicity vanishing or positivity (the only 'Serre' in the text is 'Serre subcategory'); and no small Cohen–Macaulay module result. Its nearest contact is a background citation to a companion OpenAI preprint, 'A Complete Local Domain without a Small Cohen–Macaulay Module' (cited as SmallCM, Theorem 1.1). This manuscript describes that result as a complete normal 3-dimensional C-domain with no nonzero finitely generated maximal Cohen–Macaulay module, though the cited title names small CM modules; the family claims nothing about small CM modules itself.
